serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: SuperFile: Stay in control after you share. SuperFile helps organizations protect and share sensitive files while retaining control over access. Users can see who has access, manage sharing permissions, and revoke access after a file has been shared. Security controls are built into each file. SuperFile combines dynamic key generation, layered encryption, and embedded access controls with trusted device verification and decryption in memory. Files synchronize across devices, giving authorized users access wherever they work. Encrypted sharing and configurable settings let organizations determine who can open and share their content.
